title: Chapter 2725: Saving the Other Cities
content:
Chapter 2725: Saving the Other Cities

Hearing his words, Mei Feng quickly snapped out of her daze and said, "Y-Yes! I do! They have all requested backup, and we were just contemplating whether to go and help them."

"Where?"

"Heavenly Furnace, Eastern Dawn, and Rising Sun!"

"There are teleporters that can take me directly there, right? If I go on foot, it’d be too late."

Although nobody there said a word, almost everyone had the same thought—that it might already be too late to save them.

After all, they’d lasted this long only because Sun Xinyan had sacrificed her life to lure it away, and unless the other cities did the same, it was practically impossible for them to survive this long.

If Gaia’s Heaven, considered to have the world’s strongest military, was powerless before the invader, what chances would the others have?

"Follow me!"

Realizing that time was of the essence, Mei Feng immediately led Yuan to the teleporter while Supreme General Tian and Sun Xinyan stayed behind.

As they traveled to the teleporter, Mei Feng asked, "Which city do you want to... save first?"

Mei Feng paused briefly mid-sentence when she realized the responsibility she had to place on Yuan.

Since Yuan couldn’t save all three cities at once, he could only help them one at a time, but with each visit, the others would have less chance of surviving.

"Which place is more important?" Yuan asked, not a hint of hesitation in his voice.

"Objectively speaking, Heavenly Furnace, since they produce pretty much the majority of this world’s weaponry, and if we want to fight back, we’ll need weapons. However... I doubt weapons would be of any use against the invaders, so..."

"What about the other two?"

"Eastern Dawn specializes in medicine, and Rising Sun is a jack-of-all-trades."

After a moment of silence, Yuan spoke, "Pick a number from one to three."

"W-What?" Mei Feng turned to look at him with a dumbfounded face.

"One to three," he repeated.

"Uh... two?" she subconsciously answered.

"Rising Sun, it is."

"That’s..." Mei Feng wanted to question his method of deciding who might live and who might die, but in the end, she found herself at a loss for words.

After all, it wasn’t as though they had the means to save all three of them.

As for Yuan, he didn’t have any deep thoughts about his decision and simply decided to let fate decide their fate.

"One more thing..." Mei Feng said as they approached the teleporter. "Teleportation between cities requires the other party to manually accept the teleporting party’s request, so there’s a chance we might not even be able to teleport to them."

"If that happens, we’ll try the others."

Once they arrived at the teleporter, Yuan said, "Come with me. I’ll need you to help me use the teleporters in case nobody else is there when I arrive. Don’t worry, I can guarantee your safety."

Mei Feng nodded and, without hesitation, entered the teleporter with Yuan.

A few moments after sending in the teleportation request—

"They accepted it! Get ready to be teleported!"

Yuan and Mei Feng vanished from Gaia’s Heaven’s teleporter and appeared in a massive building somewhere in Rising Sun.

To their surprise, the place was absolutely crowded with people—people who wanted to escape the city to another one.

But because the teleporter required so much energy to operate, only the wealthy and powerful could even hope to use it.

"W-Why are there only two of you?!" The teleporter’s operator cried out in disbelief after seeing that only two people had shown up.

When he saw a teleportation request from Gaia’s Heaven, he immediately assumed it was reinforcement, so he expected far more than just two individuals.

Yuan didn’t even bother to respond and swiftly wasted no time sweeping the entire city with divine sense to find the invader’s position.

Once he located the invader’s position, Yuan said, "I’ll be right back."

Without waiting for Mei Feng’s response, Yuan used Void Manipulation and disappeared into thin air.

A few seconds later, Yuan emerged from the void directly in front of the invader.

"Yo."

Before the invader—who looked similar to the one Yuan had already killed—could even process what was happening, Yuan unleashed his power and vaporized it in the blink of an eye.

"What the hell just happened?!"

The soldiers who had been struggling against the invader stared in shock and disbelief at the unexpected turn of events.

But before any of them could even utter a word, Yuan entered the void again and returned to Mei Feng’s side.

"Y-You’re back already?" Mei Feng muttered in a daze, as it hadn’t even been ten seconds since Yuan left.

"One or two?" Yuan suddenly asked.

"One."

Mei Feng hastily responded without thinking.

"Send us to Heavenly Furnace." Yuan turned to the teleporter’s operator and said.

"H-Huh?"

"HEAVENLY FURNACE! HURRY UP!" Yuan shouted, an overbearing presence suddenly filling the building.

The place instantly turned dead silent, and the operator swiftly sent a teleportation request to Heavenly Furnace.

Exactly four seconds later, Yuan and Mei Feng vanished into thin air as Heavenly Furnace promptly accepted the request.

"Huh?! Why are there only two of you?!"

Heavenly Furnace’s operator uttered the same words as the last guy, since he had the same thoughts.

Once again, Yuan completely ignored the man and swiftly located the invader.

This time, Yuan didn’t bother announcing his departure and used Void Manipulation to approach the invader.

Unlike last time, this invader sensed Yuan’s presence before he emerged from the void and struck first.

However, before it could fully unleash its attack, its entire being suddenly became encased in a large block of ice, turning it into a piece of art.

Yuan had attacked the invader from within the void, using Shiva’s Eternal Frost with extreme precision and mastery.

Compared to before his training, when he could only use such power crudely, the improvements were like night and day.

"Shatter."

The next moment, the block of ice shattered into countless fragments, killing the invader within.

"?!?!?!?"

The soldiers who had witnessed the invader’s death could hardly comprehend what they had just seen.

From their perspective, the invader had suddenly been encased in ice out of nowhere before shattering along with it.
